Bhagirath Malviya

Owner and driver, Savariya Tour Travels

I started Savariya Tour Travels three years ago because people in Bedawan needed a dependable ride to the city and back. I live here, so I know most of the families who call me.

Our Force Toofan is a sturdy vehicle that handles village roads and highway alike. Whether it is a wedding morning or a quiet trip to a temple, my promise is simple: your happiness is our responsibility.

  • Local owner from Bedawan, easy to reach by phone
  • Spacious Force Toofan for family and group travel
  • Weddings, parties, pilgrimages and daily rides
  • Fare agreed on call before the trip
  • Careful driving, comfortable seating
